workloads.name: small-book
workloads.objective: baseline overhead: about 10 levels and 100-200 small orders, a mix of every command

workloads.name: deep-book
workloads.objective: large working set: about 100k resting orders over 2000 levels, inserts and cancels spread over the band

workloads.name: matching-heavy
workloads.objective: matching efficiency: most submissions marketable and medium to large, so they sweep orders

workloads.name: cancellation-heavy
workloads.objective: order index and removal: half the commands cancel an order anywhere in a 50k-order book, none trade

workloads.name: mostly-resting
workloads.objective: insertion and book growth: almost every command rests a new order

workloads.name: quote-refresh
workloads.objective: replace-heavy quoting: about 2,000 post-only quotes on 100 levels, 60% replaces, 25% submissions, 15% cancels

workloads.name: pending-stops
workloads.objective: stop triggering: 10,000 resting orders on 200 levels and about 5,000 pending stops, with cascades

workloads.name: self-trade
workloads.objective: self-trade prevention: matching-heavy's mix with owners from a pool of 20, and FOKs that walk per order

workloads.name: immediate
workloads.objective: immediate orders: IOC limits, market orders, and FOKs (a third unfillable) against a replenished 10,000-order book

workloads.name: matching-heavy-request
workloads.objective: matching-heavy's exact stream through submitOrder(OrderRequest), owner 0

workloads.name: matching-heavy-owned
workloads.objective: matching-heavy's exact stream through submitOrder(OrderRequest), a distinct owner on every order
